# LazyRabbit

> LazyRabbit is an AI automation agency based in Chennai, India. We build AI voice agents, AI chatbots, business automation, and web & mobile apps that quietly run the repetitive work so teams can focus on what matters. We serve businesses across India and work in English, Hindi and regional Indian languages.

## About
- Company: LazyRabbit — AI Automation Agency
- Location: 715-A, 7th Floor, Spencer Plaza, Mount Road (Anna Salai), Chennai – 600002, Tamil Nadu, India
- Serves: businesses across India (and beyond)
- Contact: info@lazyrabbit.in · +91 90947 70827
- Tagline: We automate. You elevate.

## Services
- [AI Voice Agents](https://callagent.lazyrabbit.in): AI voice agents that make and answer phone calls in English, Hindi and regional Indian languages — inbound support, outbound sales, lead qualification, appointment booking and follow-ups, 24/7, with hand-off to a human when needed.
- [AI Chatbots](https://lazyrabbit.in/chatbot): AI chat assistants for websites, WhatsApp and messaging that answer customer questions, capture leads and support customers around the clock.
- [Business Automation](https://lazyrabbit.in/business-automation): custom AI-powered workflow automation that connects your tools and removes manual, repetitive back-office work.
- [Web Development](https://lazyrabbit.in/web-development): fast, modern marketing sites and web apps built to convert.
- [App Development](https://lazyrabbit.in/app-development): mobile and web application development for iOS, Android and the web.
